session.title: Short Enduro-eve recovery primer
session.purpose: Preserve a fifth low-cost bike touch while actively checking whether Wednesday's displaced Stumpjumper dose has been absorbed before Friday's Enduro exposure.
session.dose: Ride 20-30 minutes at 105-120 W and RPE 1-2 only with normal cognition, no respiratory irritation and fresh legs. A failed absorption gate converts the day to complete rest and may cap Friday to one cycle.
session.adaptation_hypothesis: Removing Thursday load preserves race-bike perception-action quality better than adding fitness work this close to Friday.
execution_rules: No torque, cadence drill, tempo, strength or mobility loading that can create fatigue.

expected_result.next_day: Friday starts with clear cognition and fresh upper and lower body.

stop_rules: Any fatigue, poor sleep, abnormal HR response, pain or CNS signal converts the day to complete rest.
